Always keep a 'talk_to_human' and 'fallback' route so no student hits a dead end.
Add regional-language utterances if your students commonly use them.
For time-bound answers (deadlines, cutoffs, results), update the placeholder values each academic year.
Test the bot with real student phrasings, including typos and short forms.
